fact: Law L/2023/019/CNT of 25 October 2023 provides that Guineans receive their NPI from the national civil register on inscription in the register of natural persons, and requires bodies using identification data to build interoperability.
title: Loi ordinaire L/2023/019/CNT du 25 octobre 2023 portant identification des personnes physiques en République de Guinée
publisher: Conseil National de la Transition, République de Guinée
